items.title: createStoreCreditAccountsStep
items.description:
This step creates store credit accounts. If no code is provided, a unique code
prefixed with "SC" is automatically generated. The step supports rollback by
deleting the created accounts.

items.title: creditAccountStep
items.description:
This step credits one or more store credit accounts with transactions.
The step supports rollback by deleting the created transactions.

items.title: debitAccountStep
items.description:
This step debits one or more store credit accounts by creating debit transactions.
The step supports rollback by deleting the created transactions.
